title: Cookbook:Beef Yakiniku Pizza
ingredients_raw: ½ red capsicum, cut into 10 pieces
600 g tenderloin beef, cut into 2 x 1 x 1 cm pieces
2 tbsp cornstarch, dissolved with 20 ml water
steps: Combine flours, yeast, sugar, water, and salt to make a dough.
Cover with plastic wrap, and rest the dough 10 minutes until expanded.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan. Add the onion and capsicum, and sauté for 10 seconds.
Add the tenderloin and the water. Add the mirin, soy sauce, and oyster sauce.
Add the dissolved cornflour, salt, and sugar. Stir until well-mixed and slightly thickened.
Separate the solids from the extra sauce. Reserve the sauce to serve with the pizza.
Roll out the pizza dough to a 10 cm diameter. Spread the meat topping on top.
Bake pizza in the oven at 220°C for 20 minutes.
Serve hot with the dipping sauces.
description: Yakiniku is a Japanese term referring broadly to grilled or barbecued meat dishes. This recipe tops pizza dough with a yakiniku-style beef stir-fry.

Yakiniku is a Japanese term referring broadly to grilled or barbecued meat dishes. This recipe tops pizza dough with a yakiniku-style beef stir-fry. 

==Ingredients==

===Dough===

* 600 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] high-protein [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 200 g low-protein [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 15 g instant [[Cookbook:Yeast|yeast]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 75 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] [[Cookbook:Water|cold water]]
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

===Topping===
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Oil|vegetable oil]]
* ½ big [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* ½ red [[Cookbook:Capsicum|capsicum]], cut into 10 pieces
* 600 g tenderloin [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]], cut into 2 x 1 x 1 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]] pieces
* 100 ml [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Mirin|mirin]]
* 2 tbsp light [[Cookbook:Soy sauce|soy sauce]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Oyster sauce|oyster sauce]]
* 2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Cornstarch|cornstarch]], dissolved with 20 ml [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]

===Spreading===

* 5 tbsp [[Cookbook:Tomato Sauce|tomato sauce]]

==Procedure==

=== Dough ===
#Combine flours, yeast, sugar, water, and salt to make a dough. 
#Cover with [[Cookbook:Plastic wrap|plastic wrap]], and rest the dough 10 minutes until expanded.

=== Topping ===
# Heat the oil in a non-stick pan. Add the onion and capsicum, and sauté for 10 seconds.
#Add the tenderloin and the water. Add the mirin, soy sauce, and oyster sauce.
# Add the dissolved cornflour, salt, and sugar. Stir until well-mixed and slightly thickened.
#Separate the solids from the extra sauce. Reserve the sauce to serve with the pizza. 

=== Finishing ===
# Roll out the pizza dough to a 10 cm diameter. Spread the meat topping on top.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] pizza in the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] at 220°C for 20 minutes.
# Serve hot with the dipping sauces.
